kind: Diagnostic controller substitution, not a new grade or model trial

detail.tolerance: Engine cap exact to .001 W; energy derivative 10 W + 0.3%; fuel 0.1 g + 1%; source forces within .1 N; >=2 s clear by .3 m before runway end, bank >.25 rad and >1 m clear at 70 s.

diagnostics.reference_equations: Independent mass points, centroid, inertia, local sections and coupled E-L solve; no candidate counters/helpers used as expectations.
